gunslinger-initiative-and-upgrade-native.head: 8035f4be537f039f78b2e04364b759799b084c71
gunslinger-initiative-and-upgrade-native.scope: Stock Actions showed the derived Gunslinger Upgrade 1075. Unloading 240 removed the grant and its individual +2 Initiative and +1 Ballistic Damage records, and reloading restored them. With both disciplines loaded, the stock Desperation cast used 10 IS, set +86 for 20 s and retained the snapshot when either parent was unloaded.

scattershot-initiative-and-upgrade-nativ.head: 8035f4be537f039f78b2e04364b759799b084c71
scattershot-initiative-and-upgrade-nativ.scope: Stock Actions showed the derived Scattershot Upgrade 1071. Unloading 245 removed the grant and its individual +1 Initiative records, and reloading restored them. With both disciplines loaded, the stock Desperation cast used 10 IS, set +86 for 20 s and retained the snapshot when either parent was unloaded.

stats.source: GOB 240 supplies Initiative Bonus 1046 +2 + the shipped Ballistic Damage +1 and grants Gunslinger Upgrade 1075 while loaded. DesperationFunction reads 1046 as a percentage at application.
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives publishes the individual loaded records and AbilityGrantRegistration registers child 1075. AbilityScaledBuffs reads current 1046 when creating the fixed Desperation snapshot. AbilityStats consumes the Ballistic Damage record in typed damage.
stats.test: GunslingerAndScattershotIndependentlyFeedTheLiveDesperationSnapshot verifies all four parent combinations against +83/+84/+85/+86, independent grant membership and typed Ballistic Damage. Stock PR918 confirms both unload/reload cycles, effects and the expiration of the +86 snapshot. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/918#issuecomment-7091415575
